name: WRIGHTWAY CONSULTING, INC / WRIGHTWAY MEDICAL
what_it_does: Durable medical equipment supplier plus accessibility home modifications and in-home assessments
notes: TWO-NAME QUESTION: ONE BUSINESS, not two. Sunbiz shows WRIGHTWAY CONSULTING, INC., document P93000014661, status Active — and the same document number also appears as 'WRIGHT WAY CONSULTING, INC.' flagged NAME HS (name history), i.e. a former spelling of the same 1993 corporation. A Sunbiz name search covering the WRIGHTWAY CONSULTING..WRIGHTWAY D range returned NO entity called 'Wrightway Medical', so Wrightway Medical is a trade name / brand, not a separate corporation. Three things tie the names together: the live site is wrightway-medical.com but its own service page carries the title 'Environmental Adaptation Services in St. Petersburg, FL | Wrightway Consulting'; both names publish the same phone 727-577-7544; and both publish the same address 2909 47th Ave N., St. Petersburg, FL 33714. THE NAMES MISLEAD IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: 'Consulting' is not a consultancy, and 'Medical' is not a clinic, a billing service or a staffing agency. Established from the company's own site: it supplies 'durable medical equipment, home accessibility modifications, incontinence supplies, and expert assessments'. (c) is settled by its own wording 'Home Accessibility Solutions — Unlock every room in your home with C.E.A.C. certified accessibility modifications' and 'custom home modifications to remove physical barriers', with a wheelchair-ramp photo captioned 'A metal wheelchair ramp with handrails...leads from a sidewalk to the front entry of a house' — C.E.A.C. is the Certified Environmental Access Consultant credential, so accessibility is a named specialty, not incidental general contracting. (d) is settled only by Medicaid-waiver wording: the about page states its billing specialist has 'deep knowledge of Medicaid Waiver billing', and it is 'in network with Coastal Care' and an 'approved DME provider for the ICMC program'. Notably its APD-facing service page is headed 'Environmental Adaptation Services' — the exact iBudget waiver service category — but the page text never names APD, the iBudget waiver, developmental disabilities, autism or sensory needs; the closest population wording is 'mobility challenge', 'aging parent' and 'child with special needs'. So an autism/DD focus specifically is NOT established. Phone and address above are published on the company's own site. Sunbiz detail pages were unavailable through this proxy, so officers are unverified.

Sunbiz detail pages also returned nothing through this proxy, so officers and principal address are unverified. WHAT IT DOES: established only at the level of 'general construction contractor' from the corporate name plus the DBPR 'Certified General Contractor' license classification. I found NO company website. Every other result was a lead-gen or contractor-marketplace directory (BuildZoom, Yelp, Angi, HomeAdvisor, Zillow, chamberofcommerce.com, thebluebook, ZoomInfo, hub.biz) and I did not take a description from any of them; a Yelp fetch was also blocked by robots.txt. So the specific scope of work — commercial vs residential, remodeling vs new build — is UNCLEAR. (c) and (d): I searched specifically for accessibility, ADA, wheelchair ramp, disability and Medicaid wording tied to this company and found NONE anywhere. Under the task's rule that a general builder with no such mention is not disability-focused, I record N for both, but flag that this is absence of evidence from directory listings rather than a company statement — with no own website there is nothing that says this contractor markets accessibility or DD work. (e) PRACTICAL ANSWER FOR A FAMILY: there is a real, contactable company, and directory listings place it at 912 Dr Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Tampa FL 33603, but I never loaded a source showing a complete phone number, so I am leaving phone empty rather than publish a partial one. Bottom line: a legitimate active Tampa general contractor enrolled with APD under the owner's personal name, with no public evidence of disability-specific or developmental-disability work.
